reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: middleware is an exported Next.js framework function (public API exception — called by the framework on every matching request, not internal callers). Gate 2: no trust_assumptions defined in BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json; entry point is unauthenticated external HTTP. Gate 3: src/app/api/ is explicitly in-scope. An attacker can trigger this via any HTTP client by sending forged non-empty cookies (oauth_user_id=x; oauth_access_token=y) to /api/admin/force-logout-all during the 22:50–23:50 JST window, causing forceLogoutAll() to execute and forcibly terminate all active user sessions — confirmed at src/middleware.ts L38 (truthy-only check) and src/app/api/admin/force-logout-all/route.ts (no auth, time-gate only). Severity retained at High; no client_diversity cap applicable.
